We moved the reading group to Thursdays. Tuesdays kept clashing with the methods seminar, and half of us were showing up late or not at all. The room is the same (Liberal Arts 204), and we still start at four.

This month we're reading the first three chapters of Kahneman's Thinking, Fast and Slow. If you only get through one, make it chapter two, since that's the one Dana wants to argue about. Bring a question or a complaint. Either works.

Snacks are on me this week. After that, we'll go back to taking turns.
